notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.114

• Face: when your face isn't recognised, DuckOS asks "Face not recognised — Try again". Tap Try again, and once your face is recognised it goes straight in — no "Continue" to tap.
• DuckPay shows your cards in DuckWallet's order, and your member cards, gift cards and tickets are there too: pick one and its barcode shows, big and bright, for the till.
• Settings › DuckTask account › Sign-in & security opens properly (your passwords password and end-to-end encryption, in a sheet).
• Privacy & security › TouchID and FaceID opens your face settings.
• Android's own screen lock and face pages are in DuckOS's colours (yellow on DuckOS's backgrounds) instead of Android's blue.
• DuckAntivirus is a page of Settings now (Privacy & security › DuckAntivirus), not an app of its own.
• DuckAntivirus trusts apps from DuckStore (WhatsApp, Discord… are no longer "from outside a trusted store").
• DuckAntivirus checks every app you install and every file you download, the moment it arrives, and tells you each time.
• DuckAntivirus › Web protection is a real switch now: DuckWeb's ad and tracker blocking.
• Lock screen: Android's bar at the bottom is hidden on DuckOS's lock screen, so a swipe from the edge no longer leaves you on Android's old lock screen.
